@deskNodeSynced.description: Node status word: the node is at the chain tip. Short, in the status rail and node panels.

@deskNodeBehind.description: Node status word: the node is behind the network. Short.

@deskNodeNotAnswering.description: Node status word: the node does not answer. Short.

@deskNodeChecking.description: Node status word while the first check is running. Short.

@deskNodeStarting.description: Local node status word: the node program is starting. Short.

@deskNodeSyncing.description: Local node status word: the node is downloading the chain. Short.

@deskNodeStalled.description: Local node status word: the sync made no progress. Short.

@deskNodeFailed.description: Local node status word: the node program failed. Short.

@deskNodeStopped.description: Local node status word: the node program is stopped. Short.

@deskNodeMarkerNoAnswer.description: Marker after the node host in the rail's second line when the node does not answer. Very short, lowercase.

@deskNodeMarkerBehind.description: Marker after the node host in the rail when the node is that many blocks behind. Very short. {count} is a number with thousands separators.

@deskNodeMarkerStarting.description: Marker after the host in the rail while the local node starts. Very short, lowercase.

@deskNodeMarkerStalled.description: Marker after the host in the rail when the local node's sync stalled. Very short, lowercase.

@deskNodeMarkerFailed.description: Marker after the host in the rail when the local node failed. Very short, lowercase.

@deskNodeMarkerStopped.description: Marker after the host in the rail when the local node is stopped. Very short, lowercase.

@deskNodeHostSince.description: Tooltip line for a node that stopped answering: the node's host and the time it went down.

@deskNodeNotAnsweringLine.description: Tooltip line when the node does not answer.

@deskNodeLatency.description: Tooltip line part: the node's answer time in milliseconds.

@deskNodeLatencyOverTor.description: Tooltip line part: the node's answer time in milliseconds, measured over Tor.

@deskNodeNewerOut.description: Tooltip line part: a newer node version is released.

@deskNodeBehindLine.description: Tooltip line when the node is behind the network.

@deskNodeHeightOf.description: Tooltip line part: the node's block height of the network's height.

@deskNodeAtTip.description: Tooltip line part: the node is at the chain tip. Short, lowercase.

@deskNodeLocal.description: Name of the node program that runs on this computer, in the rail and node panels.

@deskNodeConnectingPeers.description: Local node line while it looks for peers.

@deskNodeUsingUntilSynced.description: Local node tooltip line: the wallet reads through this public node until the local node has synced.

deskNodeNothingUntilSynced: Nothing can be sent until it is synced.

@deskNodeNothingUntilSynced.description: Local node tooltip line while it syncs and no other node is used.

@deskNodePeers.description: Local node tooltip line part: how many peers the node is connected to.

@deskNodeRunning.description: Local node tooltip line part: how long the node program has been running. {duration} is like "9 h 40 min".

deskNodeStillUsing: Still using {host}; the local node takes over shortly.

@deskNodeStillUsing.description: Local node tooltip line once synced while the wallet still reads through a public node.

deskNodeNoProgress: No progress for 5 min. Restarted once already.

@deskNodeNoProgress.description: Local node tooltip line when the sync stalled.

@deskNodeUsingMeanwhile.description: Local node tooltip line: the wallet reads through this public node while the local node is not working.

@deskNodeStartIt.description: Local node tooltip line when the node is stopped.

deskNodeFailPort: port {port} is in use by another program

@deskNodeFailPort.description: Why the local node failed, as a detail after the word "Failed". Lowercase fragment.

@deskNodeFailDisk.description: Why the local node failed. Lowercase fragment.

@deskNodeFailMissing.description: Why the local node failed. Lowercase fragment.

@deskNodeFailExited.description: Why the local node failed. Lowercase fragment.

@deskNodeFailExitedCode.description: Why the local node failed, with the program's exit code. Lowercase fragment.

@deskNodeFailDefault.description: Why the local node failed when nothing more is known. Lowercase fragment.

@deskNodeStageWaiting.description: Name of the local node's sync stage, lowercase, used inside a sentence.

@deskNodeStageHeaders.description: Name of the local node's sync stage, lowercase.

@deskNodeStageChainDownload.description: Name of the local node's sync stage, lowercase.

@deskNodeStageKernels.description: Name of the local node's sync stage, lowercase.

@deskNodeStageRangeProofs.description: Name of the local node's sync stage, lowercase.

@deskNodeStageProcessing.description: Name of the local node's sync stage, lowercase.

@deskNodeStageBlocks.description: Name of the local node's sync stage, lowercase.

@deskNodeStageCompacting.description: Name of the local node's sync stage, lowercase.

@deskNodeStageStopping.description: Name of the local node's stage, lowercase.

@deskNodeStageSyncing.description: Name of the local node's stage, lowercase.

@deskNodeLineWaiting.description: Local node stage line while it waits for peers.

@deskNodeLineHeaders.description: Local node stage line: block headers downloaded of the total.

@deskNodeLineHeadersBare.description: Local node stage line: block headers, count unknown.

@deskNodeLineChain.description: Local node stage line: chain state downloaded of the total, in gigabytes.

@deskNodeLineChainBare.description: Local node stage line: chain state, size unknown.

@deskNodeLineKernels.description: Local node stage line: kernels checked of the total, in millions.

@deskNodeLineKernelsBare.description: Local node stage line: checking kernels.

@deskNodeLineRangeProofs.description: Local node stage line: range proofs checked of the total, in millions.

@deskNodeLineRangeProofsBare.description: Local node stage line: checking range proofs.

@deskNodeLineBlocks.description: Local node stage line: blocks downloaded of the total.

@deskNodeLineBlocksBare.description: Local node stage line: blocks, count unknown.

@deskNodeLineStopping.description: Local node stage line while the node program shuts down.

@deskNodeLineSyncing.description: Local node stage line when the stage is unknown.

@deskNodeDurationHm.description: A length of time in hours and minutes, e.g. how long the node has been running.

@deskNodeDurationM.description: A length of time in minutes.

@deskTorNetworkLabel.description: Label of the Tor switch in Settings › Privacy and the status rail's Tor row.

deskTorNetworkHint: Network activity goes through the Tor network. Tor hides the wallet’s IP address: each connection passes through several volunteer-run relays, so no server learns where the wallet is.

@deskTorNetworkHint.description: Explains what the Tor switch does, in the info hover card behind the Tor switch.

@deskTorOff.description: Tor state word: the switch is off. Short.

@deskTorStarting.description: Tor state word: Tor is connecting. Short.

@deskTorOn.description: Tor state word: Tor is connected. Short.

@deskTorNotConnected.description: Tor state word: Tor stopped or could not connect. Short.

deskTorCoverage: Over Tor: Epicbox, the node, status, price, updates, support and Tor addresses.

@deskTorCoverage.description: One sentence listing what goes over Tor while the switch is on.

@deskTorNodeOver.description: Node tooltip line: the node is reached over Tor.

@deskTorNodeNotEncrypted.description: Node tooltip line: a plain http node is not encrypted after the Tor exit.

@deskTorNodeWaits.description: Node tooltip line: the node connection waits for Tor.

@deskNodeFailoverSwitched.description: Toast when the node in use stopped answering and the wallet moved to the next working node of the list for this session. host: the new node's address.

@deskNodeFailoverInsteadOf.description: Second line of the sidebar Node status and the Settings › Node head while node failover uses another node: host is the chosen node.

@deskNodeDurationDh.description: A duration of a day or more, e.g. how long the node has run: "5 d 7 h".

@deskNodeDurationH.description: A duration in whole hours, e.g. "5 h".

@deskNodeEtaCalculating.description: Local node sync: shown where the time left goes, until there is enough measured progress for a rough estimate. Short.

@deskNodeEtaLeft.description: Local node sync: a rough time left for the whole sync. {time} is deskNodeEtaMinute, deskNodeEtaMinutes, deskNodeEtaHours or deskNodeEtaHoursMinutes.

@deskNodeEtaMinute.description: Local node sync time left under two minutes, in deskNodeEtaLeft: "about a minute left".

@deskNodeEtaMinutes.description: Local node sync time left under an hour, in deskNodeEtaLeft. {minutes} is a number (a multiple of 5).

@deskNodeEtaHours.description: Local node sync time left in whole hours, in deskNodeEtaLeft. {hours} is a number.

@deskNodeEtaHoursMinutes.description: Local node sync time left in hours and minutes, in deskNodeEtaLeft. Both are numbers.
